description: Answers 'what do I still owe?' Lists the assignments in your courses that you have not handed in yet, with the course name and the due date. Drafts that were never handed in are included, and work that was already handed in or graded is left out. Up to 25 assignments in each course are checked and the list holds up to 50 items. Input: course_ids, an optional array of course IDs to limit the list; leave it out to cover all current courses. Ask: 'What work am I still missing?'

items.description: Moodle course ID. Use get_my_courses to find it.

name: get_missing_work
title: Missing work
